text: Fixed. The bug was in tree.go's findCaseInsensitivePathRec: it descended into children[0] when a node had a wildcard child, but the wildcard child is always the LAST child (static children come first), so any case-insensitive lookup at such a node panicked with "invalid node type" (or, with a naive fix, failed to match static siblings). I made the wildcard branch use the last child and try the static children first, matching getValue's precedence. Verified: routes "/a/:b/c", "/a/d", "/a/e" now resolve "/A/X/C"->"/a/X/c" and "/A/D"->"/a/d" without panicking, and the whole test suite still passes.
